snippet.title: REPOSE | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play REPOSE: https://akuparagames.itch.io/repose?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt

Welcome to your first day on the job! Corporate is coming to visit us soon and we need to clean up our work and follow the guidelines to a tee. We don’t want to be written up by anything. Go into the facility and pick up oxygen tanks that you find while you are in there. Do not go too deep. HR should give you the flashlight and axe you need to traverse through the facility.
